title: Amazing Habit Tracker
body: I’ve spent way too much time in finding the best habit tracker and nothing really suited me until I found Awesome Habits it was Amazing and exactly what I was looking for! And this is your go-to habit tracking app if you need one! The developer is really kind aswell, 10/10 App
author: Hamood7878

title: Best habit app
body: I’ve tried a few but this is the best I’ve come across. Has all the options that I want and is easy to customize. I would like to be able to nest categories but that is a minor thing.
author: NickFallows
